text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a fascinating area of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. Instead of just reading words as data, NLP allows machines to grasp the meaning behind text. This technology makes automatic translation between languages possible, breaking down communication barriers. It is also used in sentiment analysis, where companies analyze social media comments or reviews to detect whether customers feel positive, negative, or neutral about a product. Additionally, many of us interact with NLP daily through chatbots on websites. These simple conversations, whether answering questions or providing support, are powered by algorithms that continuously learn and improve. Ultimately, NLP is bringing us closer to natural, effortless communication with technology.
